published.title: The Birth and Rescue of Moses
published.summary: A Levite woman hides her baby for three months, then places him in a basket among the reeds by the riverbank. Pharaoh's daughter finds him, his sister arranges for his own mother to nurse him, and he becomes the princess's son and is named Moses.

published.title: Moses Returns to Egypt
published.summary: Moses leaves Midian with his family and the staff of God. During a dangerous encounter with the LORD on the journey, Zipporah circumcises her son. Aaron meets Moses, and the people of Israel believe the signs.

published.title: Bitter Water, Manna and Quail
published.summary: Israel finds bitter water at Marah, which is made sweet, and then grumbles for food in the wilderness. Quail arrive in the evening and manna in the morning, with a double portion of manna gathered before the Sabbath.

published.title: The Covenant and Ten Commandments at Sinai
published.summary: Israel camps before Mount Sinai and is told to prepare. The LORD descends in fire and speaks the Ten Commandments to the people, who fear and ask Moses to speak to them instead.

decisions.reason: Narrow the law block to the supplied ratification narrative in Exodus 24; omit the laws of chapters 21–23 under the narrative-only rule.

published.title: The Covenant Is Sealed at Sinai
published.summary: Moses reads the book of the covenant to the people, who agree to obey, and seals the covenant with blood. Moses, Aaron and the elders ascend the mountain; Moses then enters the cloud and remains on the mountain for forty days and nights.

published.title: Building the Tabernacle
published.summary: The people bring more than enough materials, and Bezaleel and Aholiab oversee the work. The tabernacle is set up on the first day of the first month in the second year, and the cloud and glory of the LORD fill it.
